# DeepSeek Host Requirements Quality Checklist: DeepSeek Explicit Dev Flow

**Purpose**: PR-review checklist for clarity, completeness, consistency, and measurability, focused
on (A) evolving Harness bundle/profile lifecycle evidence and (B) complete direct Core authority,
recovery, and thin-adapter boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-08-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth**: Standard
**Audience / Timing**: PR reviewer before `$speckit-implement`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark
an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are package identity, private/local packaging, embedded Core, one Skill, one STDIO integration, and deferred publication all specified without leaving an implied second delivery path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-006, Scope Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK002 Are official profile add, host restart, resolved-bundle observation, product-identity remove, second restart, and stale-metadata handling all covered as one lifecycle contract? [Completeness, Spec §US1/US3, Bundle Contract §4]
- [ ] CHK003 Are runtime selection, link-time version identity, missing/incompatible/non-executable failure, child cancellation, and deterministic reaping requirements all documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002/FR-008/FR-021, Bundle Contract §5–§8]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the child environment keys, default/override data location, no-shell/no-listener/no-network rules, and non-secret diagnostic boundary exhaustive? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007/FR-020, Data Model §CoreLaunchSpec]
- [ ] CHK005 Are every direct-result representation and recovery case—inline, domain error, near-spill, spilled, pruned, truncated, malformed, and near-Core-limit—covered by requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018–FR-024, Data Model §DirectResultObservation]
- [ ] CHK006 Are fake/package, direct-host spike, and final stable real-host evidence requirements separated with their allowed claims and required metadata? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026–FR-028, Research §Decision 9]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the provisional engineering range `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0-0` distinguished unambiguously from the still-unmet latest-stable journey requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Plan §Gate A]
- [ ] CHK008 Is “then-current supported Harness mechanism” operationalized as official-source revalidation with a stop condition rather than permission to guess changed patch/import keys? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Bundle Contract §3]
- [ ] CHK009 Is explicit `/dev-flow` invocation defined through the official user-invocable contract while conversational/empty use is a separate pre-mutation rejection? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009–FR-011, Skill Contract §1]
- [ ] CHK010 Is “complete result” measurable as complete-envelope parsing and byte/digest equality rather than visible text that merely appears sufficient? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019/FR-023, Skill Contract §5]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the raw lifecycle launcher distinguished clearly from a result projection proxy by its prohibition on parsing MCP or task payloads? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016/FR-018–FR-021, Bundle Contract §6]
- [ ] CHK012 Is “committed action” unambiguously a Core mutation result rather than a Git commit or Harness-local decision? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004, Skill Contract §4]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the shared link-time `buildVersion` seam assigned to one Feature 003 owner while Feature 004's dependency and final-build stop point are explicit? [Clarity, Plan §Gate C, Quickstart §3]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do manifest, bundle patch, profile dependency, package file allowlist, and removal identity describe one consistent product boundary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001/FR-004–FR-006, Bundle Contract §2–§4]
- [ ] CHK015 Do explicit-Skill requirements consistently prohibit implicit model invocation across spec, descriptor, bundle, and independent acceptance criteria? [Consistency, Spec §US1/FR-009–FR-011/SC-002, Data Model §SkillDescriptor]
- [ ] CHK016 Do all Core-facing requirements retain exactly six raw tools and live Core schemas without aliases, generic forwarding, or a host-specific action catalog? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013–FR-016, Skill Contract §2–§4]
- [ ] CHK017 Do direct-result requirements preserve both complete success and complete domain-error semantics across structured content, text, spill, and prune handling? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019/FR-022–FR-023, Research §Decision 4]
- [ ] CHK018 Are profile removal and shared-data retention consistent with the default data root, explicit override, compatible reinstall, and Codex non-interference requirements? [Consistency, Spec §US3/FR-006/SC-007, Bundle Contract §4/§6]
- [ ] CHK019 Are package/Core/source/fixture version and digest rules consistent across the package entity, build contract, quickstart, and journey report? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028/SC-008, Data Model §DeepSeekProductPackage]
- [ ] CHK020 Does every proxy reference consistently remain conditional on observed direct-consumption failure plus a reviewed amendment, with no proxy work implied by the current plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018–FR-022, Plan §Gate B]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are primary install, explicit new-task, compatible resume, restart/resume, Core `DONE`, remove, and compatible reinstall scenarios independently specified? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–3]
- [ ] CHK022 Are alternate profile-home, composed profile resolution, spaces/Unicode/symlink worktree, and same-host compatible-task cases addressed without expanding to multiple repositories? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases/FR-012/FR-017, Bundle Contract §7]
- [ ] CHK023 Are exception requirements complete for absent/incompatible runtime, changed Harness API, no stable release, stale profile metadata, non-Git input, multi-repository input, and cross-host ownership conflict? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases/FR-003/FR-008/FR-011–FR-012/FR-017]
- [ ] CHK024 Are recovery requirements complete for response loss, cancellation, spill, preview, prune, truncation, malformed results, and Core child exit before initialization? [Coverage, Spec §US2 scenarios 3–4/Edge Cases, Skill Contract §5–§7]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the uncertain-mutation path required to retain original request/action inputs and use a fresh Core operation probe before any retry or recovery apply? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024, Skill Contract §6]
- [ ] CHK026 Are profile removal, task-data retention, compatible reinstall, and optional Codex co-installation specified as distinct observations with explicit skip semantics? [Coverage, Spec §US3/SC-007, Quickstart §8]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK027 Can a reviewer objectively determine that installation contributes exactly one Skill and a one-to-one native catalog for all six raw Core tools? [Measurability, Spec §US1 scenario 1/SC-001/SC-003]
- [ ] CHK028 Can explicit-only behavior be measured as zero task creation for an ordinary prompt and pre-open rejection for empty/conversational or non-Git invocation? [Measurability, Spec §US1 scenarios 2–3/FR-010–FR-011/SC-002]
- [ ] CHK029 Can direct-result completeness be established for every threshold case through recorded expected/recovered bytes and SHA-256 rather than subjective display inspection? [Measurability, Plan §Gate B, Data Model §DirectResultObservation]
- [ ] CHK030 Can the real journey prove the same task lineage across restart, at least two Core-committed actions, budget compliance, and an authoritative terminal outcome? [Measurability, Spec §FR-027/SC-004/SC-006]
- [ ] CHK031 Can safe removal be measured through profile readback, absent Skill/tools, retained data, compatible reopen/resume, and Codex non-interference or explicit skip? [Measurability, Spec §US3/SC-007, Data Model §DeepSeekJourneyEvidence]
- [ ] CHK032 Can startup and shutdown bounds be evaluated from specified exit, signal, EOF, timeout, and redaction criteria without inventing host guarantees? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008/FR-021, Bundle Contract §6/§8]

## Non-Functional and Boundary Requirements

- [ ] CHK033 Is the 1,048,576-byte Core envelope bound related explicitly to observed Harness spill/prune thresholds without turning planning observations into unsupported compatibility promises? [Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context/Gate B, Research §Decision 4]
- [ ] CHK034 Are environment isolation and diagnostic redaction requirements sufficient to exclude secret-shaped host variables and secret/path/payload disclosure? [Security, Spec §FR-007–FR-008, Bundle Contract §6]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the absence of network runtime, HTTP MCP, listener, shell, telemetry, downloads, and publication behavior specified across package and launcher boundaries? [Scope, Spec §FR-020/Out of Scope, Bundle Contract §2/§3/§6]
- [ ] CHK036 Are macOS arm64 evidence and unsupported Windows/Linux claims separated from cross-build possibility and future publication scope? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions/Out of Scope/SC-008, Research §Decision 7]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 Are Feature 002 delivery, Core Contract 0.1, source identity, six-tool catalog, fixture count/digest algorithm, and envelope limit documented as auditable dependencies rather than adapter-owned rules? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Research §Decision 6]
- [ ] CHK038 Are official repository/registry links, access dates, source-to-package identity gap, and future stable revalidation requirement sufficient for a later reviewer to reproduce the compatibility decision? [Dependency, Research §Decision 1–§5]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the Feature 003-owned version seam a dependency with one implementation owner, preserved source fallback, targeted tests, and a Feature 004 build gate rather than duplicate cross-feature work? [Dependency, Plan §Gate C, Bundle Contract §5]
- [ ] CHK040 Are public publication, cache deletion, proxy implementation, other platforms, Core contract changes, multi-repository tasks, cross-host takeover, and future abstraction explicitly excluded or gated? [Scope, Spec §Out of Scope/FR-018, Plan §Evidence and Stop Gates]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify`
  and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add reviewer findings inline and link them to the affected specification or planning artifact.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
